question: About 22% of Sun-like stars have an Earth-size planet where water could stay liquid. Out of 20 billion such stars, how many billion planets?
answer: 4.4 billion planets: places to look, not places known to hold life.
move: Counting the chances is not the same as knowing the odds of each.
ask: When I hear there are many opportunities out there, do I know the odds of any single one?
hint: Turn the percentage into a fraction and multiply.
steps: 4.4 billion planets: places to look, not places known to hold life.
